feature_contract.goal: Preserve the complete authored menu and car-selection image, including content outside the nominal 4:3 centre, at native 4:3/16:9/21:9 aspect while maintaining a comfortable optical size and binocular LOCAL-fixed presentation.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only OpenXR host menu/client cropping and LOCAL menu optical coverage; never the game UI, stereo gameplay, HUD/F11/ESC, lens/GOAL/+TIME, SkyGlow, input/FFB or DX11/DXVK.
trace_stages: Original game's user-visible main and vehicle-selection sprites plus Graphics letterboxing and scaling configuration.
Game client and capture UV through R23 full-client aspect, optional original 4:3 crop and clipped fragment geometry.
R23 shared common FOV tangent optical projection and identical left/right menu quad to the OpenXR compositor.
subcomponents: Prevent destructive implicit 4:3 UV cropping based solely on a configuration flag; retain opt-in cropped A/B fallback.
Contain the entire native-aspect wide front-end at the same bounded 0.78 binocular optical coverage as explicit centre crop, without independent horizontal/vertical stretching.
Preserve full and edge-clipped capture fragment scale/translation and exact source-mode negative regressions.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Default wide native client preserves all authored selection pixels without 4:3 cropping inferred from INI settings; explicit manual 4:3 override still works.
Full 21:9, 16:9 and 4:3 menus remain optically centred and uniformly contained at the same 78% coverage; cropped and partially captured fragments retain true placement.
Unletterboxed and desktop UI, stale UV/invalid extent rejection and stereo game HUD/F11/ESC are unchanged; the prior unsafe automatic crop and full-FOV regression are caught.
DX9Ex Active x86 game, x64 host, package, full-chain compile plus Domain Isolation and affected menu/source regressions pass on the final validation-bearing Git SHA.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Real Quest3/VDXR user-tested A/B at source 1d161a18efcfe4ddf3cad318ea6be50102458ac3 observed wide menu and 4:3 crop clipping the Ferrari/car list outside the centre, irrespective of CLI static assertions.
source_trace: R23GameMenuIsLetterboxed reads configured UILetterboxing/UIScalingMode without checking sampled content pixel margins.
R23RenderWorldLockedMenuProjection previously equated that config flag with safe 4:3 authored crop, discarding real car-selection columns in both eyes.
When crop was false the host used opticalCoverage 1.0 and blew the full native client up to FOV limits; both eyes share that same LOCAL-fixed projection.
diagnosis.root_cause: UI configuration flags are not image-content proof and native menu optical sizing was incorrectly conditional on the destructive 4:3 crop choice.
alternatives_rejected: Do not assume every pixels outside original 4:3 are black letterbox rails; Quest3 screenshots showed visible car-selection content.
Do not modify game's authored menus, desktop output pixels, raw capture or per-eye aspect independently to compensate for the crop.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: The default XR menu path requires an independently verified matte before automatic crop and uniformly reduces full-client/menu optics to 0.78 common tangent-ellipse coverage; explicit reversible centre-crop override remains.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Portable C++ verifies config-vs-matte truth table; existing menu geometry/source mutation verifier now rejects auto-crop false-to-true and coverage 0.78-to-1.0, with native/clipped aspect and reset fixtures preserved.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R23 LOCAL-fixed projection uses common FOV, identical 0.78 optical containment and common captured UV in both eyes; no change to gameplay stereo eyes.

runtime_evidence: No matching Quest3/VDXR session on the new build; visual menu correctness is not yet proven.

ci_evidence.note: No CI outcome assumed for the prospective material commit.
